title: Independent history, probe, and held-out expansion for causal typed-prior evidence

B_stronger.optional_replication: one second seed or independent task subset, pre-registered as a separate replication and never pooled into the primary contrast

token_cost_assumptions.calculation: input_tokens*2/1e6 + output_tokens*8/1e6; exact provider usage replaces estimates

partitioning.selector: sort immutable gold-bearing task IDs by SHA256(phase2-v1:<partition>:<family>:<seed>:<task_id>)
partitioning.partition_manifest: must record source manifest hash, selector hash, ordered IDs, payload hashes, and pairwise-disjointness matrix
partitioning.leakage_rule: No ID, payload, answer, response, or derived candidate may cross partitions; exclusion audit is a pre-execution gate.

conditions.separate_call_required: Every distinct condition/task pair gets a distinct request body and physical model call; no response reuse across conditions.
conditions.legal_response_reuse: The exact preserved response bundle may be scored by retaining triage and destructive gating because those are local policy transitions, not model prompts.
conditions.gate_labels: Computed locally from frozen probe outcomes and never sent in a model request.
conditions.identifiability_guard: Request body includes phase2 arm, partition, family, task ID, task type, condition, candidate ID/version, typed scope, policy-state-independent prompt template ID, seed, and canonical payload hash; request hash is SHA256(canonical JSON).
conditions.policy_prompt_rule: If a policy changes the model-visible prompt or context, it is a new condition and requires its own call; retaining/destructive comparison must otherwise consume the same response ledger.

pre_registration.thresholds: Use Phase 1T frozen accept/reject/abstain thresholds unchanged.
pre_registration.minimum_probe_tasks: At least 4 per family in A and 8 per family in B, all valid after the 90% contract-validity check; a family failing this is not pooled.
pre_registration.primary_contrast: contextual_typed_prior versus global_only, paired on the same held-out task IDs but separately called responses
pre_registration.stopping: Before execution, stop a family if its formal history cap cannot yield the target supports or any hard stop fires. After the full frozen held-out set begins, no early positive stopping; only terminal safety, data-integrity, provider-exception, unknown-usage, authorization-drift, or cost-ceiling stops are allowed.
pre_registration.conclusion_gate: positive only if the pre-registered primary held-out margin and safety/retention criteria pass; negative if the pre-registered harm/failure criteria pass; otherwise inconclusive. Coverage alone never changes the conclusion.

accounting.resume: append_only exact prefix; request hashes and response hashes immutable
accounting.physical_attempt_rule: zero retries means physical attempts equal logical requests until a terminal hard stop; known-usage invalid outputs consume an attempt and continue
accounting.reward: verified answer reward and support reward are reported per 1,000 cumulative input+output tokens, including all conditions, invalid responses, fallback/candidate responses, and triage windows

capability_evidence: calibration validity and baseline answer/support/joint accuracy
verified history success rate and family coverage
method_effect_evidence: paired held-out answer/support/joint margins, helpful/harmful pairs, false-safe/false-harm, retained recovery, and destructive loss under the frozen protocol
evidence_boundary.forbidden_inference: More candidates, more supports, or broader coverage alone is not evidence that typed priors improve routing.

authorization_plan: Design only. A future run requires a new immutable authorized config, fresh provider-price verification, and explicit user authorization; this file does not enable paid_api_allowed.
